what: The public record of the cloud branch (docs/analysis_plan_models.md, Amendment 3, section 12). code_commit, code_published_at, code_published_source and the gist fields are filled after the branch's code commit is published, and key_reading (the output of `python -m judge.cloud --status`: the branch key's limit, its reset and the free daily limit) when the branch is registered, all before any request (Amendment 3, Correction, C1 and C10); the runner refuses while any is null. Times are GitHub's, not the author's clock. Amendment 3, Correction 5, C26: the owner waived a credit limit on the branch key on 2026-11-12 (key_limit_waived, key_limit_waiver: his words in Russian and in English). A key that has a limit must still have exactly 15 USD that never resets; on a key without a limit the paid arm runs only under this waiver and only on a reading of the account's credit balance that the operator takes by hand from the OpenRouter dashboard before each paid run and appends to account_balance_readings ({"balance_usd", "read_at" in UTC with its offset, "read_by", "source"}); the code cannot read the balance (GET /api/v1/credits needs a management key) and checks only the reading's form, time and size. Under the waiver the only bound is the code's caps, and the only outer bound the account's balance.

key_limit_waiver.quote_ru: это лимит никакой, там и так 25 долларов, просто работаю аккуратно и все нормально делают
key_limit_waiver.quote_en: this limit is pointless; there are only 25 dollars there anyway; I just work carefully, and everyone does it normally
key_limit_waiver.meaning: the account holds a 25 USD balance; he declines a credit limit on the key and accepts working carefully without one
key_limit_waiver.given_by: the author, owner of the OpenRouter account, in a chat message to his AI coding assistant
key_limit_waiver.what_it_weakens: no stop outside the code at 15 USD: the code's caps (15 USD branch, 5 USD per model, each request reserved at its worst case, the spend journal) are the bound; a defect in them could in principle exceed 15 USD, and the account's balance is then the only outer bound
